items.title: Akiyoshi Toshiko — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: But Clifford Brown was … if you met him, I was so surprised

ctx.x: And Max Roach was … he always played, firstly, always incredibly fast. That was his style. So, first day, it was the second day? The pianist disappeared or something. So there was a pianist living in Boston, called Joey Master, he was noted, I guess, so he was subbing. But he [Max] always played fast, so [chuckles] Joey came up to me and said, he said, “You want to sit in?” so I said [?? laughing]. Firstly, Max always played fast. And uh, the first time he had, uh … Clifford [Brown] and, uh, Sonny Rollins….
